tips.how_pair_device: For AppleTV, go to 'Settings -> Remotes and Devices -> Remote App and Devices' to enter pairing mode for completion

tips.account_invalid: There is an issue with the account. Please check logs and fix it.
tips.footer: By default, when the app expiration time is less than 1 day, it will automatically refresh between 3-6am. Apps linked to a GitHub or AltStore source are checked for new versions in the background; automatic updates are installed in the same time window.
tips.footer_external: Apps signed with an external certificate are never refreshed automatically: they stop working when the certificate or the provisioning profile expires. Reinstalling does not extend this date; import a new profile or certificate instead.
tips.reinstall_external: Reinstalling does not extend the validity, which stays bound to the certificate and the provisioning profile. Import a new profile or certificate to extend it.
tips.signing_identity_error: The signing identity (certificate, private key or provisioning profile) is invalid or not compatible. Check the log and the identity in Accounts.
tips.signing_error: Signing failed or the signed app did not pass verification. Check the log for details.
tips.transport_error: The device could not be reached or rejected the installation. Check the log for details.

toast.pair_error: Pairing error. Please check the console for more information.
toast.no_device_found: Device not found. Pleasemake sure the usbmuxd service is running.

pin.title: Enter PIN code

tips.warning: This device will emulate a MacBook. When signing in with the installation account, please ensure you have an iPhone or an authorized device nearby to receive 2FA verification codes.
tips.external: External certificate mode signs with your imported certificate and provisioning profile, without any Apple ID. The app stays valid until the certificate or the profile expires, unless Apple revokes the certificate earlier; atvloadly does not verify revocation.

toast.install_failed: Installation Failed. Please check logs for more information.

source.label: Source:
source.choose_tips: This release contains several IPA files. Choose the one built for your device (tvOS for Apple TV, iOS for iPhone and iPad). Variants such as Sideload and Sideloadly can be different apps, so keep the same one for updates.
source.choose_app_tips: This source lists several apps. Choose the one to install.

filter.label: File name filter
filter.tips: Regular expression that finds the same IPA in future releases. It is derived from the selected file.
filter.mismatch: The filter does not match the selected file.

bundle_id.label: Bundle identifier
bundle_id.tips: AltStore apps are tracked by their bundle identifier.

source.auto_update_tips: New versions are installed during the Auto Refresh running time period, even if the app does not need a refresh yet. They are signed with the same account.
source.select_build: Fetch the source and select an IPA to install.
source.choose_saved_app_tips: Your saved sources list several apps. Choose the one to install.

ipa_url.label: IPA URL:
ipa_url.external_unavailable: External certificate signing needs an uploaded IPA file

account.label: Apple Account:
account.alt: For account security, please do not use your primary account for installation.

custom_name.label: App Name:
custom_name.placeholder: Leave blank to keep the app's own name
custom_name.tips: Renames the app on the home screen. The bundle identifier is unchanged, so the app is still replaced on refresh.

extensions.tips: Useful when there are not enough App IDs available for registration
extensions.tips_external: Removes every app extension (widgets, plug-ins). By default extensions are kept and signed with the provisioning profile. Removed extensions are listed in the compatibility check.

identity.label: Signing identity:
identity.alt: The app is signed with this certificate and provisioning profile; no Apple ID is used.
identity.empty: No signing identity yet. Import a P12 certificate and a provisioning profile in Accounts.

custom_identifier.label: Custom bundle identifier:
custom_identifier.alt: Leave empty to keep the identifiers of the IPA. The identifiers of the app extensions follow the custom identifier.

allow_missing_entitlements.label: Allow missing entitlements
allow_missing_entitlements.tips: Sign even though the provisioning profile does not grant some entitlements the app requests. Features relying on them may not work.

toast.device_not_ready: Device information is not ready, please try again later
toast.mount_failed: Could not prepare the device for a screenshot

webhook.header_placeholder: Separate multiple headers with semicolons, e.g.: Authorization: Bearer token; X-Custom: value

iphone_toggle.label: iPhone Auto Refresh
iphone_toggle.tips: iPhone refresh isn't restricted by the configured running time; it will attempt to refresh when the iPhone is connected to WiFi

run_time.label: Running Time Period
run_time.format_tips: Linux crontab format, restricted by refresh mode

update.title: App Updates
update.tips: Apps installed from a GitHub repository or an AltStore source are checked in the background, and you are notified of new versions when notifications are enabled. Automatic updates are installed during the Auto Refresh running time period, even if the app does not need a refresh yet. GitHub allows 60 unauthenticated requests per hour.
update.task_disabled: Auto Refresh App is disabled: new versions are still detected, but automatic updates are not installed.

sources.title: AltStore Sources

tips.step1: Please ensure that your iPhone has Developer Mode enabled and the system version is iOS 17.4+.
tips.step2: Please download idevice_pair, connect your iPhone, and export the RPParing mode Pairing File.
tips.step3: Please use idevice_pair to enable Wireless Debugging functionality.
tips.step4: Please ensure that your iPhone device is discoverable in the Tools.
tips.step5: Automatic refresh on iPhone is not guaranteed to be reliable; the iPhone must be unlocked for remote refresh to work properly.

identity.title: Signing identities (external certificate)
identity.subtitle: P12 certificates and provisioning profiles used to sign apps without an Apple ID.
identity.notice: Signing with an imported certificate needs no Apple ID in atvloadly. Apps can be installed until the certificate or the provisioning profile expires; Apple may still revoke the certificate earlier, and atvloadly does not verify revocation.

plan.uploading: Uploading the IPA for the compatibility check…
plan.checking: Checking the IPA, the identity and the device…

codes.p12_invalid: The file is not a readable PKCS#12 (.p12) file.
codes.p12_no_private_key: The P12 file contains no private key.
codes.p12_no_certificate: The P12 file contains no certificate matching its private key.
codes.p12_key_mismatch: The private key does not match the certificate.
codes.p12_ambiguous: The P12 file contains several identities. Export a single certificate with its private key.
codes.p12_unsupported: The P12 file uses an unsupported format, encryption or key type.
codes.certificate_not_code_signing: The certificate is not valid for code signing.
codes.certificate_not_yet_valid: The certificate is not valid yet.
codes.certificate_no_team: The certificate has no Apple developer team identifier.
codes.profile_invalid: The provisioning profile is invalid or cannot be read.
codes.profile_signature_invalid: The provisioning profile is not signed by Apple or its signature is invalid.
codes.profile_not_installable: App Store provisioning profiles cannot install apps on devices.
codes.profile_certificate_mismatch: The provisioning profile does not include this certificate.
codes.profile_team_mismatch: The provisioning profile belongs to another team than the certificate.
codes.identity_duplicate: An identity with the same certificate and provisioning profile already exists.
codes.identity_not_found: The signing identity no longer exists.
codes.identity_in_use: The signing identity is used by a running installation. Try again once it has finished.
codes.identity_referenced: Installed apps still use this signing identity.
codes.key_unavailable: The signing key of this installation is unavailable, so the private key cannot be unlocked.
codes.key_mismatch: The private key was sealed with another signing key. Restore the original key file or import the identity again.
codes.sealed_key_corrupt: The stored private key is damaged. Import the identity again.
codes.workspace_failed: The temporary signing workspace could not be prepared.
codes.device_unreachable: The device could not be reached.
codes.profile_platform_mismatch: The provisioning profile does not support the platform of this device.
codes.ipa_platform_mismatch: The app is not built for the platform of this device.
codes.ipa_platform_unknown: The platform the app is built for could not be determined.
codes.device_not_provisioned: This device is not included in the provisioning profile.
codes.ipa_invalid: The IPA file is invalid or cannot be read.
codes.ipa_path_rejected: The IPA file is not an uploaded or installed IPA. Upload it again.
codes.nested_bundles_not_signed: An app nested inside another app cannot be signed with the provisioning profile.
codes.bundle_identifier_rewritten: The bundle identifier will be changed to the custom identifier; the identifiers of the app extensions follow it.
codes.extension_removed: An extension will be removed from the app.
codes.application_identifier_mismatch: The application identifier would not match the provisioning profile.
codes.wildcard_requires_binary_entitlements: The executable embeds no entitlements, so the wildcard profile cannot give it the expected application identifier.
codes.entitlements_missing: The provisioning profile does not grant some entitlements requested by the app.
codes.entitlement_value_changed: Some entitlements would be signed with other values than the app requests.
codes.application_identifier_from_profile: This bundle is signed with the application identifier of the provisioning profile, not its own. App Groups, keychain sharing, push notifications and iCloud may not work.
codes.custom_identifier_invalid: The custom bundle identifier is invalid: use only letters, digits, hyphens and dots.
codes.incompatible: The IPA, the provisioning profile and the device are not compatible.
codes.signed_output_missing: The signing engine did not produce the signed IPA.
codes.signed_bundles_mismatch: The signed IPA does not contain the expected apps and extensions.
codes.signed_bundle_identifier_mismatch: A signed bundle has an unexpected bundle identifier.
codes.signed_profile_mismatch: A signed bundle does not embed the provisioning profile of the identity.
codes.signed_certificate_mismatch: A signed bundle is not signed with the certificate of the identity.
codes.signed_entitlements_invalid: A signed bundle has unexpected entitlements.
codes.transport_failed: The device could not be reached or rejected the installation.
codes.pairing_record_invalid: The pairing record of the device is missing or unreadable. Pair the device again.
codes.certificate_invalid: The stored certificate cannot be read. Import the identity again.
